body:
Founder real-time PII audit found CarePyre contact submissions plaintext/indefinite with no deletion path, login events logging plaintext emails into a shared cross-product log, and world-readable DB files. Fixed: new carepyre_contact_submissions table + CarePyreContactHandler gated by new contacts.manage permission (Top-Admin-only, built through localUserPermissions for future extension); 90-day post-resolution retention via cmd/carepyre-contact-purge + systemd timer (deployed, enabled, verified); local/Google auth events now log local_uid/sub only, no plaintext email; var/*.db chmod 640 + UMask=0027 on the service unit. Live-verified: tests green, service rebuilt/restarted, migrations applied, 4 real historical rows migrated from IDUNA byte-for-byte, end-to-end submission tested through the live nginx proxy, purge timer's first run logged. Commit 076bc20.

⚓ ☃
title: PII audit: contact form moved here, retention purge, event-log PII minimization
